vision.tone: Plain, tense and close: three people in one courthouse records room, the turns carried by faces and long pauses, never by speeches, violence or camera tricks.
references: a courthouse records room in flat morning light seen at standing and seated eye level
a low-key procedural standoff played in pauses and glances

visual_rules.rule: Static eye-level camera, no dutch angles, no handheld shake.
visual_rules.why: The turn comes from the faces, not from the camera.

visual_rules.rule: Keep Hollis screen-left, Eli in the middle and Naomi screen-right in the morning scenes; Eli screen-left and Naomi screen-right in the last scene.
visual_rules.why: Everyone's place stays readable and the cut never flips who is where.

visual_rules.rule: One person moves or handles one prop at a time, never together; no hand-over and no contact.
visual_rules.why: Hands on small props and two bodies in contact are the least reliable things the video model does (film01, film04).

visual_rules.rule: Paper never shows legible text: pages stay face down, turned away from the camera or out of focus.
visual_rules.why: Generated text on a prop cannot be trusted to read correctly.

visual_rules.rule: Singles keep the counter edge, the green wall or the door frame in frame.
visual_rules.why: film05: a close single reads as standing or seated by chance; the furniture makes posture readable.

facts.text: A sealed exhibit has to reach grand jury room 3B upstairs by eleven

carriers.detail: Nothing's leaving the building. It goes upstairs to 3B by eleven.

facts.text: Hollis fears the old case of Calvin Reed, who was convicted nine years ago

carriers.detail: Calvin Reed. That's the one, isn't it? Somebody's crying about Reed.
Reed was nine years ago. The jury took forty minutes.

facts.text: Hollis calls Eli 'son' as a form of address: he trained Eli, they are not related

carriers.detail: You've been here six months. You don't decide what happened, son.

facts.text: Once the wax seal is broken it cannot be closed again and the opener's name is recorded

carriers.detail: If that seal breaks in your hands, it can't go back.

facts.text: The custody form on the packet carries only Naomi's name and times

carriers.detail: Bell, nine-oh-four. Bell, ten-thirty-eight. That's all it says. Just you.

facts.text: Naomi warned Hollis three times not to open the packet

carriers.detail: I can't tell you. I'm warning you. Those are different things.
Second time, Sergeant. Opening that won't end what you're afraid of.
This is the third time I'm saying it. Don't open that.

facts.text: Hollis breaks the seal in front of Eli's body camera

carriers.detail: HOLLIS breaks the red wax seal of the packet
Ten fifty-four. Exhibit forty-one, seventeen, A. Seal broken by Sergeant Hollis.

facts.text: The grand jury cover sheet names Hollis as the subject of an investigation into six cases

carriers.detail: The line underneath it names the subject of the investigation.
Six where the weights changed before trial. Your signature both times.

facts.text: Eli refuses to turn his body camera off

carriers.detail: I can't, Sarge. You know I can't. And I won't.

facts.text: Calvin Reed's evidence weighed eleven grams at intake and fifty-two at trial in Hollis's handwriting

carriers.detail: At intake it was eleven grams. At trial, it was fifty-two.
Eleven grams is a misdemeanor. Fifty-two was nine years. Your handwriting.

facts.text: The clerk upstairs has called Hollis up and he leaves on his own

carriers.detail: Two marshals are coming down. The clerk wants you upstairs.

facts.text: Hollis has been indicted and suspended, his certification gone

carriers.detail: Suspended. His certification's gone. Trial's set for March, they're saying.

facts.text: Calvin Reed has come to collect his belongings after nine years

carriers.detail: Any minute. He's coming for his property envelope. Nine years shelved.
CALVIN walks in through the hallway door

facts.text: Calvin signs the ledger for his belongings

carriers.detail: You don't owe me anything. Sign for your things. They're yours.
CALVIN signs the ledger page with the pen
